clue.text: Write in with directions about plagiarism

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means going round, so the compass letters are placed on either side of the copying word

parts.note: S and E are the compass points south and east
to crib is to copy someone else's work, so a crib is plagiarism

explanation.surface: An instruction to fill something in, following directions about copying others' work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts CRIB inside S...E, the two directions, after IN taken as written.
explanation.definitionFit: To inscribe is to engrave or set down words, a formal way of writing.

clue.text: Serving popular fish could be good thing for one's standing

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
sole is a flatfish

explanation.surface: Serving a fashionable fish dish might do wonders for one's social standing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing' reads as social status, but the definition means standing on one's feet: a shoe lining helps there.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushioned inner sole of a shoe makes standing on your feet more comfortable.

clue.text: Clubs for employees

definitions.meaning: clubs are heavy sticks or poles, like a walking staff
a company's ... are its bodies of workers

explanation.definitionFit: Clubs are stout poles, and a firm's workforces are its personnel; one word covers both senses.

clue.text: Tell of a minister losing his head

indicators.note: losing his head means the minister's word drops its opening letter

parts.note: a prelate is a senior churchman, a minister of religion

explanation.surface: A story told about a clergyman who is beheaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing his head' removes the P from PRELATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate a story is to recount or narrate it.

clue.text: Book space to have a stab at witchcraft

parts.note: room means space, as in room to move
to stick is to stab or pierce

explanation.surface: Reserve a slot to try your hand at magic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'witchcraft' reads as sorcery, but here it is a witch's craft, the vehicle she flies on.
explanation.definitionFit: A witch traditionally flies on a broom, so it is her aircraft in the vessel sense of craft.

clue.text: Article fifty-one specifies the weapon

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
an ace is a one in cards and dice

explanation.surface: A legal provision, article fifty-one, names the weapon in question.
explanation.definitionFit: An anlace is a short medieval dagger, a type of blade.

clue.text: Person who spins yarns

parts.note: spinning yarns looks like textile work, but here it means telling stories

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tells a story or recounts events is one who spins yarns in the storytelling sense.

clue.text: A coir mat can be quite fragrant

indicators.note: can be suggests these letters may become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A coconut-fibre doormat is surprisingly sweet-smelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be' rearranges the letters of A COIR MAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with a pleasant, spicy smell is aromatic, a synonym for strongly scented.

clue.text: Flat music heard in church

parts.note: even means level or flat
a song is a piece of music

explanation.surface: Dull, monotonous music sung during a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flat' looks like a criticism of the music, but it simply means level.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening prayer sung in Anglican services is something a congregation hears in church.

clue.text: The main base

parts.note: main is an old word for the ocean, and base its bottom

explanation.definitionFit: The bottom of the ocean is the base of the main, an old poetic name for the open water.

clue.text: Taking over, go for cut

indicators.note: taking in the sense of seizing and working over shows these letters are to be reshaped

explanation.surface: Taking control, someone decides to opt for a reduction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking' rearranges the letters of OVER and GO.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove is a long narrow channel or furrow cut into a surface.

clue.text: From beginning to end

parts.note: the span from birth to death, beginning to end of a person's existence

explanation.definitionFit: The whole duration of someone's existence runs from birth to death.

clue.text: Artificial flowers

parts.note: flowers here means things that flow, so man-made waterways

explanation.definitionFit: Man-made waterways are channels of water that flow, built rather than natural.

clue.text: Break to stretch out — such a bloomer!

parts.note: to snap is to break
to drag on is to go on too long, to stretch out

explanation.surface: A break that goes on and on: what a blunder!
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder, but here it means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The garden plant antirrhinum blooms with bright flowers, so it is a bloomer.

clue.text: Note strain induced when it's over-loud

indicators.note: induced suggests the letters are brought into a new form by some outside force

explanation.surface: A note that strains the voice when it's far too loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'induced' rearranges the letters of NOTE STRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A stentorian voice is extremely powerful and booming, named for the loud herald Stentor.

clue.text: Finding a great many in charge competent and friendly

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a great many
able means competent

explanation.surface: Discovering that a lot of the people in authority are both capable and pleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Amicable means goodwilled and peaceable in dealings with others.

clue.text: The making of secret changes without penalty

indicators.note: changes shows these letters are to be rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Making secret alterations and getting away unpunished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' rearranges the letters of OF SECRET.
explanation.definitionFit: To get off scot-free is to escape any punishment; scot was an old tax.

clue.text: Poet showing devotion to delicate stuff

parts.note: love means devotion
lace is a delicate fabric

explanation.surface: A poet displaying fondness for fine fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Lovelace was a 17th-century English Cavalier poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Lovelace was a Cavalier lyric writer of 'To Althea, from Prison'.

clue.text: This makes for swell viewing!

parts.note: swell looks like slang for great, but means enlarge: an instrument that magnifies what you look at

explanation.definitionFit: A lens instrument enlarges tiny things, making them swell in view.

clue.text: A man of decision

parts.note: decisive person in the character sense, but literally someone whose job is making rulings in sport

explanation.definitionFit: A sports official makes the decisions in a game, such as calling a batsman out.

clue.text: A quarter frequently relax

parts.note: S, south, is one of the four quarters of the compass
often means frequently

explanation.surface: Someone in one part of town takes it easy regularly.
explanation.walkthrough: The four quarters of the compass are N, E, S and W.
explanation.definitionFit: To relax a rule or attitude is to make it less strict, to ease it.

clue.text: The essence of the French people

definitions.text: The essence of the French people

parts.words: The essence of the French people
parts.note: essence is the word French speakers use for motor fuel

explanation.definitionFit: In France motor fuel is called essence, so it is the French people's essence.

clue.text: A clipper? No, a smaller vessel

definitions.meaning: a clipper is one who clips, a person or tool that trims
a small single-masted sailing boat, smaller than the clipper ship

explanation.surface: Is it a clipper ship? No, it's a lesser boat.
explanation.definitionFit: One who clips or trims is a trimmer, and the word also names a small single-masted sailing boat.

clue.text: Sound instrument extensively used

parts.note: an instrument making sound that is played by extending a slide a long way

explanation.definitionFit: This brass instrument is played by pushing its slide out to varying lengths, so it is used at full extension.

clue.text: Turned back painters to irritate the treasurer

indicators.note: turned back shows the pieces that follow are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: RAs are Royal Academicians, members of Britain's Royal Academy of painters
to rub is to chafe or irritate

explanation.surface: Painters turned back to annoy the person who looks after the money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned back' reverses RAS and RUB together, giving BUR and SAR. RA is a member of London's Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.definitionFit: A bursar manages the finances of a college or school, its keeper of funds.

clue.text: Scintillating silver bedding

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
litter is straw bedding for animals

explanation.surface: Sparkling silver sheets on a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Scintillating means sparkling, and aglitter describes something glittering brightly.

clue.text: A number, but not all, excel eventually

indicators.note: but not all shows only part of these words is used, a run taken from inside them

explanation.surface: A certain number will excel in the end, though not every one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not all' picks the letters from inside EXCEL EVENTUALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleven is a whole number, the count after ten.

clue.text: Inside — given bird — for taking in a novice on the outside

indicators.note: on the outside means these letters go round the bird word, enclosing it

parts.note: in is read from taking in, the action of bringing within
L is a learner, the plate a novice driver displays
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: An inner part given a bird, for adopting a beginner from outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the outside' places IN, A and L around TERN. L stands for learner, from the L-plates novice drivers display.
explanation.definitionFit: Internal means located within, on the inner side.
